title: Month-end supplier invoices
corrections_applied: The December hold applies to Schäfer only, not every supplier. The controller releases it after checking the November statement.
teachback: You start with the oldest due invoices. For each one you check the PO and goods receipt. Equipment over €5,000 always goes to capex 0400, and you never book capex without an asset number from the plant. Schäfer double-bills every December, so you hold their December invoices until the controller has checked the November statement. Anything from the Czech subsidiary in Brno goes to the controller for a second approval. Small invoices from known suppliers you just post. If you don't know a supplier, you stop and ask the controller.
